objective: Preregister 12 candidates for T-20260929-10 (owner research-list item 3, reopened dir:vix_term_structure_short_vol): long-only-ETP dual-VIX-signal volatility risk premium (Zarattini/Aziz/Mele 2025, SSRN 5316487, per the QuantConnect replication). 10 mechanism candidates (3 RV-window variants of the full 2-signal combo, signal-1-only, signal-2-only, each in SPY-remainder and SHY-remainder versions) plus 1 internal RAND placebo and 1 static 50/50 SMH/QQQ external control, for scripts/screen_batch.py --batch h20260929_10_vix_vrp_etp --iteration h20260929_10_vix_vrp_etp. No return, Sharpe or backtest number is computed in this dossier.

keep_rule.K1: net-10bp Sharpe (D freq, single version -- no offset sweep) >= 1.1882 anchor AND >= 0.6447 stress, positive 20bp CAGR both windows. 10 primary (VVRP_*) candidates only.
keep_rule.K2: a 63-session trailing-inverse-vol monthly blend of the candidate with S3 beats a vol-matched k*S3+(1-k)*SHY control by >=0.05 Sharpe in BOTH windows. Primary candidates only.
keep_rule.watch_recent: anchor-window Sharpe >= 1.1882 but stress does not clear its bar -- forward-tracked only. Primary candidates only.
keep_rule.strong_keep: K2 edge >= 0.10 in both windows, or K1's Sharpe in both windows is >= S3's own (1.4853 anchor / 0.8059 stress).
keep_rule.placebo_and_benchmark_internal_falsifica: a primary candidate otherwise kept is demoted to not_kept if VVRP_RAND_PLACEBO or STATIC5050_SMH_QQQ's judged anchor Sharpe >= its own anchor Sharpe.
keep_rule.pass_requires: K1 OR K2, primary candidates only, subject to placebo/benchmark demotion.
keep_rule.multiple_comparisons: This iteration's own n_trials=12 (10 primary + 1 placebo + 1 static control). A manual 10-candidate-only DSR is additionally reported in report.md.
